children: shares jumped about 7% Thursday after Piper Sandler identified accelerating user growth, snapping a four-session losing streak.

Average users increased 8% month over month in August, Reddit's strongest monthly gain of 2026, following a 2% decline in July. Total audience growth accelerated to 18% year over year from 12.8%, according to Piper's analysis of Reddit Ads Manager data.

The improvement came from the platform's Feed audience, which more than offset declining Conversation users. International growth provided the strongest contribution, surging 29.3% in August compared with 19% in July. U.S. users increased 5.2%, while weekly momentum has remained strong since early July.
Why Reddit's September Reset Is Not a Warning

Piper expects an approximately 20% reduction in Reddit's September audience-size estimates because the company changed its Ads Manager forecasting methodology. The brokerage emphasized that this is a one-time measurement reset rather than evidence of deteriorating user activity.

The revision affects audience forecasting but does not change advertising auctions, optimization or delivery. That distinction matters because a sudden reported audience decline could otherwise appear to signal weakening advertiser reach or engagement.

The broader advertising environment also strengthened. Piper said August spending across its digital advertising dataset finished 60 basis points above expectations, with notable outperformance from Netflix
Piper increased its third-quarter digital advertising growth estimate by 30 basis points and raised its Reddit ad-spending forecast by the same amount. Meta Platforms
also traded higher Thursday alongside other advertising-supported platforms.

For Reddit investors, the most encouraging signal is international Feed growth, which could expand the platform's advertising inventory and monetization runway. The next tests are whether August momentum persists, advertisers maintain spending, and Reddit converts international users into advertising revenue efficiently. Investors should treat September's mechanical audience reset separately from the platform's underlying operating trends.

title: Piper Sandler Spots Powerful Growth Signal for Reddit
